0022600122.text: The Dallas Mavericks (1-2, on a one-game losing streak) visit the Miami Heat (0-3, on a three-game losing streak) for this regular-season game, which is Dallas's fourth of the season. Five Mavericks are out: Caleb Martin (thumb sprain), Dereck Lively II (foot surgery), Naji Marshall (illness), Santi Aldama (knee surgery), and Tarik Biberovic (heel inflammation). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and their 2025-26 season series was split 1-1, with Dallas winning the last meeting 118-108 in Dallas on December 3, 2025.
